8fb0dc56d82f0e4d80133fe3c44379cfe0c4b19a.description: A stone bath in a room of the gallery, pebbles round it, an armchair beside it.

da653aeb02e5495b6a9b92454533205d19eac05a.title: desk
da653aeb02e5495b6a9b92454533205d19eac05a.description: A desk and an armchair by the window.

2771165774a52fe73498daf097e7b1924d0013b9.description: Goats beside a path between the domes.

291807b4b289b578f99a32f20ab570d8cf63c0c5.description: A rotting log on the forest floor.

490556e3d0875212540b8baa870ddedf683b1cda.description: A wooden playground between the domes, the master dome behind it.

02f4682c591ceed6419c5cf1af6236c0c48d1dbd.description: The planet in avenCITY Sandbox 2, with 180 hearts waiting to be minted.

ae2c6ef857c53d839dd0bf22033b0820380b1c6c.title: first login
ae2c6ef857c53d839dd0bf22033b0820380b1c6c.description: A new citizen: 0.00 in the wallet, and +500 waiting on the Mint button.

b37defc1ef11a63e4f61cf393b0cf051883c67fb.title: first mint
b37defc1ef11a63e4f61cf393b0cf051883c67fb.description: The first mint: 500 hearts, owed to nobody.

8bfcdb0808397b78306e9e9c8935eb5211aec036.title: day 19 spuds 01
8bfcdb0808397b78306e9e9c8935eb5211aec036.description: At first light… the glass above the forest begins to glow, and a small city wakes inside its own garden.

399edf6dcd7558645c12c5c1ba5c5a2b07eda6d7.title: day 19 spuds 02
399edf6dcd7558645c12c5c1ba5c5a2b07eda6d7.description: Not long ago, the people who live here bought almost everything they ate from far away… carried by trucks across a tired land.

6084fb81fb65af1e9803caf651ccf0823fd9468a.title: day 19 spuds 03
6084fb81fb65af1e9803caf651ccf0823fd9468a.description: Here… breakfast grows twenty paces from the bed.

c85216bcfc8815964d96827c1fae7dea0c015f98.title: day 19 spuds 04
c85216bcfc8815964d96827c1fae7dea0c015f98.description: Every home opens onto a wide terrace… and every morning begins at the edge of the canopy.

27cda35428451706559284c9f1ee7317fed90573.title: day 19 spuds 05
27cda35428451706559284c9f1ee7317fed90573.description: Beneath each dome, mango and fig, coffee and cacao climb in layers toward the light… and the soil beneath them is never left bare.

6bafb035b4b7010deea0aebe9e3d79f17c9bda08.title: day 19 spuds 06
6bafb035b4b7010deea0aebe9e3d79f17c9bda08.description: The glass that shelters them is also their power… every pane quietly turning sunlight into the electricity that runs their homes.

7b112fdbbd08373be4b504ffa6abcd022a8878fe.title: day 19 spuds 07
7b112fdbbd08373be4b504ffa6abcd022a8878fe.description: Between the domes grows a food forest… fruit and nut trees, berries and vegetables in layers, hens beneath the trees, geese by the water… and bees among the blossoms.

86c34d4c6736294cac650f85f3e5a56194b23e06.title: day 19 spuds 08
86c34d4c6736294cac650f85f3e5a56194b23e06.description: Almost everything the people here eat… they grow together, a few minutes' walk from home.

16b14c61449c36fed3ef2cc4052cc60247dd4e8b.title: day 19 spuds 09
16b14c61449c36fed3ef2cc4052cc60247dd4e8b.description: Thirteen domes stand together in one ring. Two hundred and thirty-three people… close enough to know one another, far enough apart to hear the stream.

5d3fa59f5217c7500ae12a0552a6b8b9d04e5d0c.title: day 19 spuds 10
5d3fa59f5217c7500ae12a0552a6b8b9d04e5d0c.description: At the centre, the great dome is their commons… the workshops, the kitchens, the stone theatre… where young and old learn from one another.

49592fba81affabc36dd564dbd095aea640250c2.title: day 19 spuds 11
49592fba81affabc36dd564dbd095aea640250c2.description: Nothing here was handed down from a distant capital. Every dome was raised by the people who now live beneath it.

e4741b3081f733c17ca6564ac94dd12f36d6b9a5.title: day 19 spuds 12
e4741b3081f733c17ca6564ac94dd12f36d6b9a5.description: In the evening, the terraces fill with voices… and the forest below grows quiet.

a014f513f6a5e1369bf4ec733dac564e28f6b7fa.title: day 19 spuds 13
a014f513f6a5e1369bf4ec733dac564e28f6b7fa.description: And as night falls… and the lights come on along the forest paths… it becomes clear what they have built. Not a shelter from the world… but a better way to live in it.

0fa1e0014afb92607afdcb7f92e0f3e0f31e1790.title: goats
0fa1e0014afb92607afdcb7f92e0f3e0f31e1790.description: A few soft goat bleats in a quiet sunny meadow, a small goat bell tinkling as they graze, birds far away, gentle

2240cbbadefb4c89e9c50509df8f5c254f8c4f68.title: day 19 d hook
2240cbbadefb4c89e9c50509df8f5c254f8c4f68.description: Two hundred and thirty-three people live here… and almost nothing they eat comes from further than a few minutes' walk.

8eb8e81ca8f95c15996f61d8ceefe6cf4053a16c.title: day 19 d 01
8eb8e81ca8f95c15996f61d8ceefe6cf4053a16c.description: As the sun rises… the glass above the forest begins to glow, and a small city wakes inside its own garden.

22710421c8dd79bdc3d7e183db174284eab762a9.title: day 19 d 08
22710421c8dd79bdc3d7e183db174284eab762a9.description: Almost everything the people here eat… they grow together. Picked ripe, eaten fresh, never sprayed… and never more than a few minutes' walk from home.

a602a1fc67af46b8b77266e25f7a895440d232eb.title: day 19 d 09
a602a1fc67af46b8b77266e25f7a895440d232eb.description: Thirteen domes stand together in one ring… close enough to know one another, far enough apart to hear the stream.

afe72d1358d21b744a354aa1465ca1513d28ae3a.title: day 19 d 10
afe72d1358d21b744a354aa1465ca1513d28ae3a.description: At the centre, the great dome is their commons… the workshops, where young and old learn from each other, and a stone theatre, open to every one of them.

373048a0beecf79a1c1041cd77b43ed8d2865154.title: day 19 d 12
373048a0beecf79a1c1041cd77b43ed8d2865154.description: In the evening, lanterns glow along the terraces… and the forest below grows quiet.

f392c807c75f2fa38adabe086bc95701c10cfab8.title: dawn chorus
f392c807c75f2fa38adabe086bc95701c10cfab8.description: Dawn chorus in a lush forest at sunrise: many songbirds, distant and near, gentle and airy, no wind, no people

b663781598745c432553f4bc544642724600b967.title: cold wind
b663781598745c432553f4bc544642724600b967.description: Cold, lonely wind blowing over empty flat land, hollow and bleak, no birds, no traffic

1914dca5b50a9f0cc55320ecc6c78c2a0d8c7e36.description: Oppressive low drone of a distant motorway: an endless roar of traffic, diesel engines and tyres, a low industrial hum underneath, unsettling and heavy, no music

4d34f215c6e292bc385692aae02eeb8ed7917f51.title: commons
4d34f215c6e292bc385692aae02eeb8ed7917f51.description: Inside a vast sunlit glass dome garden: songbirds under the glass, a small fountain trickling, very distant soft murmur of people and a child laughing far away, warm and peaceful, no music, no machines

46e638bd4b75170f5450ffe1ec7232d22bfb0da0.title: crickets
46e638bd4b75170f5450ffe1ec7232d22bfb0da0.description: Warm summer night in a forest garden: crickets and distant frogs, very calm, soft

ec63e7d66166fe119d76abb832ee1ff077f46eae.description: Reverse cymbal swell sucking in for two seconds, then one deep cinematic low boom with a long dark tail fading into silence

8bbd14b92078058f71888fc91233a516e32cc5d2.title: truck pass
8bbd14b92078058f71888fc91233a516e32cc5d2.description: A heavy lorry passing by on a distant highway, a long doppler whoosh and diesel rumble in an empty windy landscape, lonely

d4ae234054ed8d36b2c14a104b2c1c38992c3825.title: air horn
d4ae234054ed8d36b2c14a104b2c1c38992c3825.description: A long distant lorry air horn blast echoing across flat empty land, harsh and lonely, wind around it

044e58504895e10963eb13eef303b8c7684826f2.title: morning birds
044e58504895e10963eb13eef303b8c7684826f2.description: Close, bright morning birdsong right outside an open window: a blackbird and a few small songbirds, warm and intimate, gentle air

cda4f556c62f50acc13f221c098c7341d4a498cc.title: whoosh orbit
cda4f556c62f50acc13f221c098c7341d4a498cc.description: Slow soft cinematic air whoosh passing wide overhead, gentle, airy, no impact

2cc8e24903d8c60a09a7d2a022741683831350aa.title: sub hit
2cc8e24903d8c60a09a7d2a022741683831350aa.description: Soft deep cinematic sub bass hit with a long warm reverb tail, gentle and emotional, not aggressive
